notes: The stated object of the game is finding shells in a small dense area built around exploration, which is Adventure's collectathon loop, so it leads; playing as a hermit crab on a wild shore is genuinely an animal sim too, so Roleplay & Avatar Sim is named second and this was close. I took wilderness-open from that second genre rather than Adventure's usual world-open, because the cove is a natural biome with no settlement that the player inhabits as a creature, and it costs no more than P0. Scavenger Hunt is the preset, with its shape swapped as above and its tracker-quest dropped because the shells are counted in an inventory rather than posted on a board — collectible-nodes becomes the shells themselves and alcove-secret the tide pools and rock crevices that reward poking around. Deciding without a user: the author confirmed collecting is endless, so nothing places an end to the run, and the shallow water rides on the shape's own description rather than taking the water option, since a crab walks the shallows instead of swimming them.
